product_metadata.title: Leaf Blower, 21V Cordless Leaf Blower-460CFM 130km/h with 3.0Ah Battery Powered Electric Leaf Blower with 6-Speed Control for blowers for Lawn Care and Snow Blower for Yard Cleaning
features: 【Super Strong Wind 】Upgrade high-speed high-horsepower copper motor, High power motor with constant temperature technology is adopted to ensure stable performance in high-intensity operation.The leaf blower has enouoh power to provide super strong wind.

【Super battery life】Our machine can work for 1 hour at Low speed. Compared with other blowers, our machine has a longer working time, It can work continuously for about 45 minutes under high-speed.operation.
【Fast charaing】The battery is equipped with a fast-charging device, The charaing speed is twice that of other brands which brings you a good experience.

【6 Adjustable Speeds】 Our blower provides 6 Adjustable Speeds. You can set the wind speed of the blower according to the object to be cleaned. Easily blow away your leaves in the yard, snow, and blowing dust from hard-to-clean corners.

【Cordless Leaf Blower】 This cordless leaf Blower comes with 6.0Ah battery and charger, no fues, no gas, no cord, Perfect for the courtyard, garage, the car inside and engine compartment, etc. Cordless design allows you to clean up anywhere wanted.
